svg.title: Every configuration beside 24 agent sessions
svg.desc: Each of 18 configurations beside 24 agent sessions of the traces with the largest contexts, a row under its family, in panel a its voice-to-voice p95 on a log scale against the SLO of 2.02 s, the median of its runs and their range, and in panel b the agents' tokens a second over the calls' first 240 s, only preempt-resubmit, the lifecycle policy over make-room and the configuration to deploy within 1 s of the SLO: tuned vLLM 10.14 s at 3,552 tokens/s; 1,024-token steps 8.79 s at 3,888 tokens/s; a KV watermark 10.65 s at 3,649 tokens/s; a queued-token limit at least 30 s, 48 turns failed, at 5,584 tokens/s; a token reservation 5.67 s at 3,551 tokens/s; a static cap (2 agent requests in flight) 8.57 s at 3,446 tokens/s; a static cap (8 agent requests in flight) 9.88 s at 3,586 tokens/s; vLLM with #54530 10.93 s at 3,624 tokens/s; SGLang 0.5.22 12.05 s at 3,577 tokens/s; SGLang with HiCache 11.95 s at 4,330 tokens/s; llm-d's flow control 10.99 s at 3,684 tokens/s; SMG 1.13.0 11.05 s at 3,446 tokens/s; preempt-resubmit 2.59 s at 3,593 tokens/s; the lifecycle policy over make-room 2.06 s at 3,355 tokens/s; the lifecycle policy alone on tuned vLLM 10.99 s at 3,633 tokens/s; the KV preemption 5.77 s at 3,572 tokens/s; the change 3.23 s at 3,540 tokens/s; and the configuration to deploy 2.19 s at 3,362 tokens/s.
